title: Relation to George Lewis; Willie Pajeaud's band and quadrilles
summary: He says he is no relation to George Lewis, but played with Lewis and in Willie Pajeaud's band for dances and quadrilles.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Didn't you have a list of questions about that? Yeah, I wanted to ask you some more about other people named Lewis, you know. Who, George Lewis? Yeah, are you akin to anybody else named Lewis? I just-

No, no. I played with George Lewis and Willie Paggio. Willie Paggio, George Lewis and Harold Dejon and all that bunch. We were Paggio's band and at some time we, I was supposed to go with George Lewis. And I was playing with George Lewis just before he, you know, he'd taken a sequel, he decided not to run all of them down the road, but he was playing spot jobs, you know, when he felt up to it here in town, because I was supposed to go. We didn't know a relation at all. We could be distant cousins. I don't know what, you know, them old people, you know what happened to Wade Brackley, you don't know,
but I was playing with him. I just wanted, because it seemed to be a dozen musicians named Lewis.
Well, that's the trouble, a lot of them guys I never knew in the name. Son Puglo was a drum player.
Yeah. His name was Robert Lewis. Yeah. He used to play with the

Ricca band. Willie Paggio had the Ricca band. And I used to play with the jazz band with Willie Paggio too. Where were you playing with Willie? Well we used to play all down in Beerus and Delco Islands and Mason Conventions and Shreveport. We used to go all over with him just before Willie died. I was playing with him then. We used to go all over and play. Did you play that quadrille with Willie ever,
you know, when he played the quadrille with Sonny Henry and those guys? Well I have played quadrilles

down there for the Creole Fiesta. Yeah, that's what I was. Down at the Autocrats. Yeah. Yeah. I think Willie played it at the... Mm-hmm. I used to, all of those fellas, I played with them, uh, usually the best bands, you know, Sam Dutre and all that bunch. We played together. And two times, you know, on and off.
